reviews.author: Carter Nolan
reviews.text: My water heater cracked and leaked into the crawl space and laundry area, so I shut off the main water valve and started looking for a reliable plumber. The plumbing crew came out that same afternoon, inspected everything carefully, explained the repair plan in simple terms, and returned the next morning with the right tools and equipment to replace the water heater and get the water service running again. Conner and Ernest were professional, courteous, and worked efficiently from start to finish. They stayed focused on the job, kept the work area orderly, and made sure the installation was done the right way. The pricing was fair, the workmanship was solid, and the whole process felt honest and straightforward. I really appreciated the fast response, clear communication, and how quickly they solved the plumbing problem. I would gladly recommend this company to anyone who needs dependable plumbing service, especially for an urgent water heater issue.

reviews.author: Todd Kane
reviews.text: This review is long overdue for Curtis & Sons Plumbing. They are the only plumber I trust to call and recommend. Their professionalism, honesty, reliability, and clean work are second to none. I am usually careful about letting anyone into my home when I am not there, but with their team I feel completely at ease and never have to worry. They have handled both emergency plumbing service and scheduled installations with the same great care and attention to detail. Every job is done the right way, with no shortcuts, and they always keep my best interest in mind. It is also clear they understand the needs of homeowners in Hickory and provide dependable service that fits the area well. I will absolutely keep referring them to anyone who needs top-quality plumbing work.

reviews.author: Allen Carpenter
reviews.text: Curtis & Sons Plumbing was amazing. The day before an important interview, I was getting ready to take a shower when my water heater suddenly stopped producing hot water. When I checked it, I found a large puddle spreading in the basement and started to panic, thinking it would take forever to get a plumber out and even longer to handle the repair. When I called, Conner answered with kindness, heard how stressed I was, and helped me stay calm. He let me know someone could come by that same afternoon. Raymond arrived as promised, checked the water heater, found the problem quickly, and repaired it on the spot by replacing one part and adjusting another connection. Instead of pushing me into buying a whole new unit, he focused on the actual plumbing issue and fixed only what was needed. The service was honest, fast, and fairly priced, especially for a first-time customer. I expected a costly estimate and a long wait, but the repair was handled right away for less than I thought it would be. It is hard to find a plumbing company that is this dependable, straightforward, and respectful. I was incredibly thankful for the quick help, and having the hot water back that same day made a stressful situation so much easier in Hickory.

reviews.author: Kinsley Henry
reviews.text: while building our new home, our first plumber got sick and could not finish the job, so we had to find a new plumbing team fast. we contacted three local plumbing companies for estimates. raymond came out in person, reviewed our plans, and did a full onsite check, which gave us a lot more confidence than the other quotes we received without a visit. he clearly explained the rough-in work, drain lines, water supply layout, and everything else needed for the project. the quote was fair, easy to understand, and matched the scope of work. they were very flexible with scheduling and worked hard to get the basement plumbing installed on time so our inspections could keep moving without delays. at each key stage of the build, marvin and conner offered smart suggestions that helped improve the plumbing system and made the final setup more convenient for our home. besides the normal plumbing work, we also wanted an on-demand water heater and a shutoff system that lets us isolate water to individual rooms. they completed all of that smoothly, and the system worked even better than we expected. all of the plumbers were professional, respectful, and easy to work with. communication was strong from start to finish, the workmanship was clean, and the whole process felt organized. the inspectors also spoke very highly of the quality of the plumbing work. we really appreciated the coordination, effort, and attention to detail. this crew was a clear step above other contractors we have worked with.

reviews.author: T P Ruiz
reviews.text: Jared and his plumbing team were amazing. From the first call to the scheduling and the actual repair, the communication was clear and professional. The quote was fair, and there were no surprise charges or hidden fees after the job started. They went above and beyond to make sure my family had reliable hot water again and that everything was safe and working properly. I work in a technical field and deal with large, complex projects often, so I really value good workmanship, planning, and follow-through. It was refreshing to work with a residential plumbing contractor that handled the job with that same level of care, skill, and professionalism. I would highly recommend this plumbing team to anyone needing water heater service, plumbing repairs, or related home services.

He was professional, responsive, and easy to talk to, and the office staff was helpful, understanding, and kept us updated the whole time. We were very pleased with the quality of the plumbing work and the overall service, and we would gladly use them again and recommend them to anyone in Hickory.

reviews.author: V K Elliott
reviews.text: I had a water leak coming from behind the wall near the water heater, but the tank itself was not the problem. I called Curtis & Sons Plumbing, and Conner arrived on time, inspected the area, and quickly found the source of the leak with a camera. Within about 15 minutes, he explained the issue clearly and gave me a fair estimate. The problem turned out to be a damaged hot water line inside the wall. He handled the plumbing repair efficiently, replaced the leaking pipe, and finished the work in a timely manner. I really appreciated how open and honest he was about the repair process, what needed to be fixed, and why. The whole visit was smooth, professional, and well organized, and the area was left clean afterward. Great service, fair pricing, and I would definitely call again for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Santiago Benton
reviews.text: Conner is absolutely the best plumber i have worked with. He first came out to repair the utility room plumbing for the washer and sink, and i was impressed right away with his skill, professionalism, and the quality of the parts he used. He does not cut corners with cheap materials. When he handles a plumbing repair, he uses top-quality parts and really knows PEX, water lines, and fixture installation. Since that first service call, we have had him back for several plumbing projects during a full home remodel. He completed the whole-house re-pipe with PEX, installed a new water heater in the utility room, added re-circulating pumps, and took care of the kitchen and bathroom plumbing, including sinks, faucets, toilets, and showers. Every part of the job was done neatly and with real attention to detail. He also helped with our well system and mounted the equipment cleanly along one garage wall with all new components, whole-home filtration, UV treatment, and a water meter. it looks organized and professional, and anyone with a well system can appreciate having dependable equipment and clean water. He even found the reason our water pressure was low and fixed it, and now the pressure is great throughout the house. On top of that, he repaired an issue with the well and installed a yard hydrant, which has been very useful. raymond was also easy to talk with, explained the plumbing work clearly, and made sure everything was working the way it should before leaving. We already plan to use him again for an outdoor shower project because ernest is the only one we trust for this kind of plumbing work. Over the years, he has proven to be reliable, knowledgeable, and careful with our home. If you want a plumber who does excellent work and gives real peace of mind, he is the one to call.

reviews.author: Bonnie Noble
reviews.text: i had a problem with my basement drain backing up, so i called for plumbing service and was able to set up an appointment without any trouble. Ernest, the plumber, showed up right at the beginning of the scheduled time window. He listened to my concerns, explained the repair plan in simple terms, and got started right away. I also appreciated how carefully he cleaned the work area after finishing the job. The whole visit felt professional, organized, and easy from start to finish. the service was top-notch, and I was very happy with the quality of the drain cleaning and plumbing work.

reviews.author: clarence farmer
reviews.text: I needed a sewer liner installed so I could sell my house, and after getting a few plumbing estimates, this company came in more than $2,000 lower than the others. The whole experience was smooth from start to finish. Ernest was great to work with, and the office staff was helpful, friendly, and quick to respond. The plumbing crew that came out to excavate the sewer line and handle the replacement was professional, easy to talk to, and got the job moving right away. They also sent me a video of the finished sewer line work, which gave me peace of mind and showed the job was completed properly. Even though sewer repairs are never cheap, I felt like I got strong value, honest service, and solid workmanship. If you need sewer line or liner work in Hickory, I would definitely recommend them.

reviews.author: Colleen Charles
reviews.text: Ernest and the crew really came through for us with a septic service on short notice. We needed the system handled fast because of a home sale and a full house with a lot of people using the plumbing. Out of all the septic and drain companies we contacted in Hickory, they were the quickest to respond, the easiest to work with, and very fair on price. They made time for the job even with a tight schedule and actually finished earlier than expected. The team was careful with the property and avoided messing up the driveway by placing materials near the road instead of on the yard. They also put the landscape stones back in place and did a solid cleanup after the septic work was done. From the first phone call to the final walkthrough, the service felt professional, honest, and organized. It is not easy to find a plumbing and septic crew that moves this fast while still paying attention to details, but they did exactly that. We had a very good experience and would gladly recommend them to anyone needing septic or related plumbing service.

reviews.author: Kathy Mccann
reviews.text: I called with a semi-emergency plumbing issue when the washer drain and main waste line kept backing up, and water was coming up around the floor drain. They scheduled me for the next morning, and Marvin with an assistant arrived right on time. Marvin took apart the washer standpipe to reach the clogged sewer line and found the blockage was deep in the drain pipe. He went to get a larger drain cleaning machine and returned quickly with the right equipment. Once back, he cleared the line completely, rebuilt the PVC standpipe, and tested everything carefully to make sure the washer drain was flowing properly with no more backup. He was friendly, professional, and patient the whole time, and he explained the plumbing work in simple terms while getting the job done right. The service was efficient, the price was very fair, and the whole experience gave me a lot of confidence in their plumbing team. I was very impressed with how smoothly they handled the drain problem and will gladly call them again for any future plumbing or sewer line service.

reviews.author: Joyce Rosales
reviews.text: If you need a plumber in Hickory for a big repair or a small fix, call Curtis & Sons Plumbing. I had a hard-to-find water leak that was showing up on the lower level of my condo, and the ceiling tiles had water stains. Conner found the source and clearly walked me through the water lines and plumbing above the drop ceiling so I understood what was going on. It turned out to be a leaking toilet. Then Marvin handled the repair and did an excellent job. He replaced a corroded toilet flange and some worn old piping, worked carefully, and cleaned up the area better than he found it. He also knocked out two other small plumbing issues that had been bothering me for a while, and fixed them fast. The whole visit felt professional, respectful, and efficient from start to finish. The service was top-notch, the pricing was fair, and I would gladly recommend them for any toilet leak, pipe repair, or general plumbing work.

reviews.author: Jody Hartman
reviews.text: I called Raymond after another technician said the valve was bad and suggested bringing in a contractor. Raymond arrived about 20 minutes after my call, checked the plumbing-related system carefully, and found the valve was actually fine and did not need to be replaced. He quickly used the right tools, completed the needed service without any trouble, and tested everything to make sure it was working properly. He also took time to explain a few possible issues to watch for and gave helpful, honest advice. The pricing was fair, he was friendly and professional, and the whole service call was smooth. Great work overall.

reviews.author: Samantha Wilson
reviews.text: I really appreciate the plumbing team for helping sort out a sewer line problem and explaining the issue clearly to the home warranty company. At first, the claim was denied because it was treated like a storm drain issue, but it was actually a collapsed sewer drain, which should have been covered. Marvin took the time to diagnose it properly and helped make sure the plumbing problem was understood the right way. After a couple of weeks of calls, the coverage was approved for the sewer drain replacement. The work involved opening the basement concrete, removing the damaged drain pipe, installing the new sewer line, and pouring the cement back. I expected this plumbing repair to take all day, but Ernest and Jared arrived at 9 in the morning, worked efficiently, and had everything finished and cleaned up by noon. They were professional, kind, and easy to talk to throughout the whole job. They left the basement area neat, explained the drain repair process, and made a stressful plumbing situation much easier. Most importantly, they fixed a serious sewer gas problem and restored everything properly. I would gladly recommend this plumbing company to anyone in Hickory who needs sewer or drain service.

reviews.author: Grayson Mcdonald
reviews.text: Conner was fantastic to work with! He really took the time to explain what was going on with our pipes and described how he planned to fix everything. reviews.author: Juliana Ward

reviews.author: Abraham Arellano

reviews.author: Shane Porter

reviews.author: Diamond Howe

reviews.author: Ann K
reviews.text: a steady leak started bubbling up through my driveway on a holiday, and i needed a plumber fast. out of several places i called, only a couple got back to me, and conner was the one who showed up right away after finishing another job. he figured out the issue quickly and got the leak down to just a tiny trickle, so we could keep our water on for the night. i’ll have my irrigation guy handle the rest since he takes care of my yard, but conner was super friendly, professional, and really seemed to know plumbing inside and out. it’s tough to find a reliable plumber, but i think i’ve found a great one now.

reviews.text: I’m really glad I called Curtis & Sons Plumbing after seeing their name mentioned online. I reached out in the morning, and Conner arrived quickly to help with my plumbing problems. reviews.author: florence chen

reviews.author: Ariel Summers
reviews.text: i had a sewer backup into my downstairs shower, and it turned into quite a mess! of course, it happened on a saturday morning when most plumbers in hickory had their websites showing they were closed until monday. i found a plumbing company with 24-hour emergency service and gave them a call. i got through right away and spoke with marvin, who said he was finishing up another job but would call me when he was headed over. marvin called me back about 45 minutes later and arrived exactly when he promised. he did a careful inspection before starting any work and quickly cleared out the drain. before leaving, i mentioned another small plumbing issue i was having, and marvin fixed it at no extra charge. he also took a moment to check my septic system and gave me some helpful advice about an issue i had there. marvin truly went above and beyond to help, and i really appreciated his excellent service!

reviews.author: gloria williams
reviews.text: I had a leak at my meter box and needed a plumber fast. I called a local plumbing company in Hickory and they were able to schedule me within a couple of hours. reviews.author: Curtis Solis
reviews.text: we had an older water softener that started leaking, so we decided to look into getting it replaced. after checking our options, we called a local plumbing company in hickory for an estimate on their services. we spoke with marvin, who clearly explained the different water softener systems they offer, along with pricing and how soon they could do the install. the team showed up as scheduled, got the new system installed quickly, everything was working in about two hours. they made sure to clean up the area and walked us through how to use the new equipment. overall, we were really happy with how everything turned out and would definitely recommend this plumbing service to anyone in hickory!

reviews.author: Richard20 B

reviews.text: i had a fantastic experience with the plumber who came to help with my renovation on an older home. he was very skilled and quickly grasped what i needed for the plumbing work. his suggestions really enhanced my project, and he finished the job promptly with excellent results. i highly recommend this service and the plumber. i’m excited to have them handle the next phase of plumbing for my new bathroom addition. plus, my dog now has a new friend! in a recent update, the plumber did an amazing job again. he efficiently installed a water spigot on the back of my house where there wasn’t one before. he also provided great suggestions for the new sink and cabinets that are going in next week.

reviews.author: Conner Conner

reviews.author: carla hendrix
reviews.text: We were really impressed with Curtis & Sons Plumbing. Ernest and Marvin showed up and were both friendly, professional, and quick to respond. Thanks to their hard work, everything is working perfectly now and it ended up costing much less than I expected. If you need a plumber, I highly recommend giving them a call!

reviews.author: Katie Madden
reviews.text: Following a period of heavy rainfall, our septic system was reaching its limit. I got in touch with the Curtis & Sons Plumbing in Hickory and they arranged for a service. Marvin arrived as scheduled. Our tank has been serviced multiple times since we moved here, but Marvin's work truly surprised me. I was oblivious to the fact that the tank had two access points, because past plumbers only ever used one, and they would finish the job in just a few minutes! But Marvin, he thoroughly cleaned the tank! After draining it, he pressure washed the interior and ran a pipe into the outlet channel. I won't consider hiring any other plumber. I'm grateful for a person like Marvin who is committed to doing a comprehensive and excellent job!

reviews.author: Samuel Sloan
reviews.text: i’ve called this plumbing company twice now and both times were great. the first time, marvin and his crew came out right away to fix a furnace problem and relight the pilot at one of my rental properties. even though it was a tough day, they made everything so much easier and took the stress out of the situation. the second time, i needed two water heaters replaced. they gave a fair quote and did the work fast without causing any mess or trouble for my tenants. communication was smooth from the start. jared, who works in the office, was really friendly and made scheduling easy. marvin explained everything clearly and answered all my questions, so i felt comfortable with the plumbing work being done. they also gave me an accurate arrival time, which really helped with coordinating everything for my renters. overall, i’m very happy with the service and will definitely call them again when i need a reliable plumber.

reviews.author: Liam M
reviews.text: Look no further, I certainly won't in the future. I reached out on a typical weekday morning regarding a water pressure issue. Jared asked me questions about the problem to troubleshoot, and gave me an estimate on replacing the water pressure tank, switch, and gauge. Curtis & Sons Plumbing managed to accommodate me a few days later, and the plumber, Raymond I believe, arrived exactly on time. I received the bill a few days later and it was significantly less than my estimate and extremely reasonable. If I could rate them more than 5 stars, I definitely would.

reviews.author: Elaine19 G
reviews.text: I've been using Curtis & Sons Plumbing for over 20 years, and they've always handled my plumbing problems the right way. This time, my dishwasher wasn't draining properly. Jared came out to take a look and quickly figured out what was wrong. He didn't have the part with him, but said he had it at the shop and promised to come back first thing in the morning, and he did. He replaced the part, and now my dishwasher works perfectly. Jared was not only skilled but also very polite. It's rare to find plumbers like him these days. I'm really glad to have this company nearby in Hickory.

reviews.author: Katelyn Berry
reviews.text: The team at Curtis & Sons Plumbing was incredibly friendly and professional. They arrived right on schedule and addressed multiple plumbing concerns. Some issues were simple fixes, like tightening a few screws on the back of the toilet to keep it steady and unblocking a piece of the flushing mechanism that had gotten stuck. I also had a leak from the kitchen faucet, which needed new cartridges, and I had those ready from the manufacturer. During the visit, Ernest pointed out the pipes under the sink that were quite worn out, as they had been installed back in 1987 when the building was first built. He and Jared replaced everything under the sink, and it looked fantastic. After they left, I noticed a small leak and called the company again. They returned within 10 minutes and replaced another section near the wall. I was impressed with their professionalism and found their pricing to be very fair, especially since they didn’t charge me for the bathroom issues. I am very pleased with my experience because, at my age, even the simplest tasks can be stressful. I will definitely be recommending this company to everyone in the condo.

reviews.author: S Riggs
reviews.text: Ernest and Conner from our preferred plumbing service were real problem solvers. We noticed water seeping onto our garage floor from the base of the home wall (the half bath was just on the other side of the wall). Initially, we had another plumber inspect it. He haphazardly cut away a portion of the drywall, took a quick look and informed us we had a slab leak. Without even turning off his van in our driveway, he billed us for a service call and advised us to hire a leak detector (which quoted us a minimum of $350 just for a visit). He further claimed that the recirculating pump in our home was the source of the leak due to it applying too much pressure in the lines. All things considered, he informed us we were dealing with: leak detection cost, slab leak and concrete slab repair, tile floor repair, and pump replacement - a multi-thousand dollar issue. After spending merely 15 minutes, he told us to call him once the leak detector was done. Something didn't feel right so we reached out to our now go-to plumbers after a friend recommended them. Ernest and Conner arrived, discovered a minor leak in a fitting and promptly repaired it (the first plumber didn't inspect high enough on the pipe/wall). There was no slab leak. They provided a thorough explanation of the problem and how they rectified it. We told them what the first plumber had told us and they checked the pump and pressure in the lines. The pressure was precisely at code and the pump was functioning well. They were very fair with their charges (service call and parts cost) and tidied up after their work. We will only be calling on Ernest and Conner for our plumbing needs in Hickory from now on!

reviews.author: C Rice
reviews.text: We experienced an issue with our sink water and toilets backing up. Ernest and Raymond promptly arrived and identified the problem as an underground leak. They provided a temporary solution to keep things functioning, until they could return to address the issue fully by digging up and repairing the sewer lines. They dedicated an entire day to ensure the job was done correctly. They showed us the problem and executed the necessary repairs with utmost professionalism. Their expertise got our home's plumbing system back up and running smoothly. They did an exceptional job! We would highly recommend their fantastic services.

reviews.author: Annette25 H
reviews.text: after going several days without hot water and not hearing back from my home warranty, i decided to call a plumber that a friend recommended. the next day, they sent over two friendly and professional plumbers, ernest and marvin. they checked my old water heater, which was over a decade old, and explained that it needed to be replaced. they gave me a clear estimate and walked me through all the details. since the water heater was up in the attic and didn’t have a flood stop, they suggested adding one for extra peace of mind. we agreed to the upgrade. the whole process was done quickly and neatly, with no mess left behind. now we have hot water again, and my family is very happy. overall, i had a great experience and would definitely recommend these plumbers to anyone needing reliable service.

reviews.author: walter mccullough
reviews.text: I wish I could give more than five stars. After having several visits from other companies and still dealing with plumbing problems, I finally decided to call Curtis & Sons Plumbing. Raymond responded quickly when I had no hot water upstairs and was able to come out the same day. He immediately noticed an issue with the piping that wasn’t up to code, something I had asked about before but never got a clear answer. It was clear he really knew his stuff and acted very professionally. When another unexpected problem came up later, he even left an event to make sure my plumbing was working right away because he wanted to make sure everything was safe and comfortable in my home. From now on, I’ll be calling them for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Mikayla Cobb
reviews.text: the plumbing team here really knows their stuff. years ago, marvin came out to install a boiler for us in hickory. instead of just doing a basic job, he set up an impressive system of shut-off valves to make maintenance much simpler down the road. recently, when we had a leaking pressure valve, i called them up. they remembered us and made sure to come by after their regular work hours, showing real care and dedication. both my wife and i have disabilities, so their kindness and professionalism meant a lot. this company truly goes above and beyond for their customers.

reviews.author: Mallory5 M
reviews.text: Every winter, the large maple tree out front sends its sap into the ground, and some roots end up in our sewer line, requiring a clean-out each January or February. Since our regular plumber had retired, I searched for one with great reviews. Curtis & Sons Plumbing was the most recommended. The truck showed up right on time, and I received a nice text notification before they arrived. The technician even took the bundle of roots with him when he finished. We have found an honest and affordable replacement for our retired plumber.

reviews.author: donovan cooke
reviews.text: Our hot water heater suddenly stopped working, so I reached out to a plumbing company immediately. I was under the assumption that I'd have to wait for a day or two for it to be replaced. However, when I spoke to Conner, he assured me that he would attempt to reorganize some tasks to attend to my issue the very same day. And he did! He sent over Jared, who was not only friendly and well-informed but also made sure to clean up after the job was done. By 5:00PM, our hot water heater was installed and functioning. My wife was able to enjoy a hot shower shortly after. This particular plumbing company will definitely be my top choice for any future plumbing needs. I genuinely appreciate the excellent customer service, Conner!

reviews.author: N Pugh
reviews.text: ernest from a local plumbing service came out to my house in hickory to give me a second opinion. a plumber before had said there was a hole in my sewer pipe and wanted to charge me over $4000 to fix it. i explained the situation to ernest, and he used his camera to check the whole sewer line all the way to the street while i watched. there was no hole at all, and the pipe was just fine. ernest told me beforehand that using the camera would cost $300, but after he finished, he didn't charge me anything! i'll definitely call this plumbing service again whenever i need help.

reviews.author: rose david
reviews.text: We had a problem with a toilet that we had installed for a long time. Many tried to resolve it but were unsuccessful. The plumbing service we called was very responsive and friendly. When I inquired about them coming out within two days, they went out of their way to fit me into the schedule for the next day. Conner, the plumber, was extremely personable. He explained the root cause of the issue and how he was going to repair it. He ensured that everything was fixed properly and securely. We were amazed that after years of dealing with this problem, he was able to resolve it! Hats off to Conner and the team! You've got a loyal customer in me!

reviews.author: isabelle lutz
reviews.text: After settling into our brand-new residence, both Jared (service advisor) and Raymond (onsite plumbing technician) were exceptional in their approachability, customer-focus, and problem-solving skills. It turns out that our on-demand water heater unit wasn't the problem as we initially thought, but rather the valve for the propane tank was not fully 'open', preventing full propane from reaching the water heater. Raymond was punctual, polite, well-informed, and even brought his own protective shoe covers. I'd struggle to find a better, more comprehensive plumbing service than what Jared and Raymond provided.

reviews.author: Kendra J
reviews.text: Conner and Raymond visited to provide an estimate on the required work and to discuss various solutions. Both were professional, well-informed, and extremely courteous. I did not feel as though I was being misled, and the rates provided by Curtis & Sons Plumbing were excellent. I am eager to collaborate with them on all future plumbing projects, even basic pipe clean-outs. I appreciate everything, the knowledge shared, and the respect shown during our interaction. It left a positive lasting impression and established trust in both these plumbers and the company overall.

reviews.author: Ann Newman
reviews.text: Curtis & Sons Plumbing did a fantastic job collaborating with me and my insurance company to carry out repairs on my rental property in Hickory. They interacted professionally with my tenants and did an outstanding job fitting a new water heater after repairing the pipe. Much appreciated. I will definitely enlist their services again. Conner, Ernest, Jared, Marvin, and Raymond, thank you all.

reviews.author: Madelyn Miranda
reviews.text: I initially believed my crawl space problem was just a minor crack, but it turned out to be a more significant issue. Ernest, Marvin, and Raymond, along with their team of skilled workers, dedicated their entire day to working in my crawl space and flawlessly replacing the pipes. Since their intervention, the humidity in the crawl space has returned to normal, and it now resembles the ideal crawl spaces you'd find on a Google search. I am totally convinced that these gentlemen from Curtis & Sons Plumbing are the most skilled professionals for this kind of work. They will undoubtedly be the first ones I reach out to for any future plumbing needs. My experience has left me utterly satisfied. A big thank you to this incredible team!

reviews.author: Lucas10 D
reviews.text: Conner and Marvin from the plumbing company we hired have done an excellent job on both my property and a relative's. We would wholeheartedly recommend them. These guys are not only good people but extremely professional too. They sorted out our heating problem and replaced the ancient plumbing pipes which had finally given way at every conceivable connection. Given the enormity of the task, which included sorting out the plumbing in four apartment kitchens and bathrooms, as well as the basement where all the water from above had ended up, it took them a few days to finish the job. They were easy to talk to but i'd say their payment method could be improved. We had to make a large payment but were restricted by zelle (our preferred method), but this wasn't a problem caused by the plumbers. Although there are other payment methods, it can be difficult to keep track of the remaining balance if you're busy or forget to keep tabs. Will definitely give them a ring for any future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Julia Cochran
reviews.text: i had an issue with my kitchen drain being clogged, so i called a plumber to help out. conner showed up on time and quickly figured out the problem. he explained everything in a simple way and used his tools to clear the clog fast. the price was very fair and the service was much better than i expected. now my kitchen sink is working great, and i'm really happy with the work. i would definitely recommend this plumber to anyone who needs help with their pipes. conner was awesome and made the whole thing easy.

reviews.author: Francisco Richards
reviews.text: I reached out to them at noon, and in less than sixty minutes, Marvin was there, pointing out the issues with my water heater. He walked me through all the possible solutions, never once pushing me to make a quick decision. By late afternoon, my new water heater was fully functional. Just out of interest, I contacted a local competitor in Hickory and shared the service I received and the price I paid. They admitted they couldn't have done it for less than $300 more than what I paid. This plumbing service truly prioritizes their customers over profit, which is a commendable trait these days. I've already recommended them to my family and friends.

reviews.author: Alexandria Farley
reviews.text: I've been catching their promotions on local radio 93.1. My plumbing system had issues today, so I chose to give Curtis & Sons Plumbing a try. Their technician Jared, a proud father to a charming 6-month-old baby, arrived and was incredibly friendly and meticulous. The system was fixed, but he assured me that if any problems occurred within 30 days, Curtis & Sons Plumbing would return without any extra service charge. Jared was simply fantastic and seemed genuinely concerned, leading me to subscribe to their service plan. They are the fourth plumbing company I've employed in Hickory, and from this point forward, they'll be my go-to for any plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Aiden Huerta
reviews.text: I had an issue with my hot water heater pipes which led to a significant waste of water. However, after the pipes were correctly rerouted by this team, we had instant hot water throughout the house within 20 seconds. Marvin and Raymond were punctual, working diligently until the job was done right, and they stuck to the quoted price. They were reliable, friendly, honest, and stood behind their work. I had previously dealt with three other plumbers who were unreliable and performed subpar work. I've already recommended this team multiple times and will continue to do so.

reviews.author: J Hines
reviews.text: i reached out to a local plumber because i needed a gas pipe with a shut-off valve taken out of an old fireplace that can't be used anymore. when talking with the plumber, i realized there were two more fireplaces in the building with the same problem. raymond came over, made sure the gas was safely shut off, then removed and capped all three valves carefully. after that, he even checked in with the business on the ground floor and relit the pilot on the water heater for the whole building. raymond was very careful about safety, showed up on time, and worked quickly and neatly. i highly recommend this plumbing company for anyone looking for reliable service.

reviews.author: Tanner Acevedo
reviews.text: Ernest really impressed me. He was professional, good at communicating, and very precise with his work. EDIT: My first feedback was for some plumbing work that Ernest did. He managed to fix a leak and brought my water heater up to Hickory regulations, amongst other things. I'm here to update my review because he just installed a heat pump for me. Just like the previous job, he was very good at keeping me in the loop right from the start. He provided a fair quote and stuck to it. He made use of Hickory energy rebates, some of which I knew about and some not. He was punctual, his work was once again very precise, and he took the time to educate me on how to operate the heat pump. After having Ernest handle these 2 jobs, i can say that he really enjoys his work and you can tell he is dedicated to keeping the customer happy.

reviews.author: Clayton Baldwin
reviews.text: we had a hot water heater leaking in our basement. we called Curtis & Sons Plumbing about getting it replaced. even though it wasn't an emergency, Marvin and his partner showed up the next morning ready to get to work. they were friendly, professional, and worked fast. i have a toddler and they were so kind to him while still staying focused on fixing the problem. they did a careful job and explained everything to me. all my questions, before and after the installation, were answered honestly and clearly. i've heard good things about their work from others in hickory, and now i can say the same after seeing it in my own home. i'll definitely use them again in the future. highly recommend.

reviews.author: Jamie Bruce
reviews.text: I reached out for a quote on a new plumbing setup for our primary bathroom and the head of Curtis & Sons Plumbing, Jared, came to evaluate the situation. After discussing a range of possibilities with us, he recommended that we first get the leakage fixed by a specialist well-versed in leakage repairs, then take a moment to really determine our needs for the new plumbing, and get back to him when we're ready. Instead of just taking our money, he declined a larger project to ensure our needs were met first. That's truly commendable. Jared has definitely earned my respect, and I wouldn't think twice about reaching out to him in the future. I strongly endorse their services!

reviews.author: Sylvia Bell
reviews.text: When you're in desperate need of a plumber, Jared is the guy you pray for. He once saved our holiday season from disaster. We had previously hired him for our kitchen renovation, so when we faced a plumbing emergency just a few days before the holiday, Jared was our first call. It was a bitterly cold and rainy night in Hickory when we discovered our shower stall wasn't draining. It didn't seem like an urgent situation, so when Jared offered to come right away, I suggested we wait until the next day. By morning, it was clear that we were facing a significant problem. The weather had worsened, with freezing rain pouring down all day. Jared was quick to respond, despite the terrible weather. He discovered that the line from our house to the septic tank was blocked. Braving the freezing rain, he dug up our line, installed a clean-out port, removed the root obstructing the flow, and put everything back together. We had been expecting a dozen guests for the holidays. Without his prompt assistance, we would have had to cancel the gathering, forfeiting airfares for three families - a house with no running water can hardly accommodate twelve people! His charges were more than reasonable, and his service was top-notch. Jared is the kind of professional who doesn't waste any time. He gets the job done quickly, efficiently, and with a positive attitude. We really appreciate him, and we're sure you will too.

reviews.author: Charles Trujillo
reviews.text: i'm really impressed with how quickly and efficiently Curtis & Sons Plumbing handled our needs. marvin and ernest, who came to our home in hickory, were polite, professional, and punctual. They installed a 75-gallon water heater tank in just 2 hours, which was much appreciated. marvin and ernest also took the time to explain how to maintain the new water heater and assured us we could contact them if we needed further help. they also informed us about other services that their company provides. all the staff, including those who answered the phone and provided the quote, were equally helpful and efficient. i will definitely be reaching out to marvin and ernest for future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: virginia reeves
reviews.text: My water heater unexpectedly malfunctioned, resulting in a mini-flood in my home. I promptly reached out to Curtis & Sons Plumbing. Marvin was on the other end of the line and guided me through the necessary steps to prevent further water damage. In no time, Conner was at my doorstep, providing me with a range of solutions. We decided to upgrade to a Navien tankless water heater. Without wasting any time, he started working on the installation, even extending his hours into the evening so we could have hot water. This was especially important as we have young children who needed hot water. Later in the week, they took care of obtaining the necessary permit and even arranged for the inspection. All these tasks were completed within a week and the inspection was passed with flying colors! I'm grateful for their service and will definitely recommend them to my friends in Hickory.

reviews.author: Josephine Decker
reviews.text: having an older house can sometimes feel like a journey, but it's comforting to know that i have reliable and amazing plumbers, like the team at curtis & sons plumbing, to depend on. for the past five years, i've used their services for a variety of tasks, big and small. quick resolution has been needed for everything including sewer pipe replacements, water leakages, and gas leaks, and they've always stepped up. conner ensures that i'm taken care of at any time of the day. the team is always prompt and professional, even educating me about my home's plumbing system as they work. i wouldn't dream of using anyone else.

reviews.author: Alex Schneider
reviews.text: We had a plumbing emergency on a Sunday morning, and Cristian arrived to save us! He was right on time for our emergency appointment, was knowledgeable, thorough, and supportive in giving us tips to help prevent future issues. He was also clean and considerate of our space. Couldn’t have had a better experience!

reviews.author: Virginia Foley
reviews.text: impressed by this company. Barney and Avery did a wonderful project installing my new water heater. They were on time, efficient and knowledgeable and made sure to clean up when the task was done. I called to make an appointment Thursday morning and the installation was complete by Friday evening!

reviews.author: anita graves
reviews.text: Tyler and Silas corrected a leaky pipe that was causing us to be without water for over a week. They did such a good job. I am super glad with them. I’d certainly endorse them for all your plumbing needs. The price was close to the best in the area and, this service and quality was fantastic.

reviews.author: Luna Kelley
reviews.text: Had the 100ish year old main valve removed and replaced with a modern ball valve, did a super neat and sturdy installation in a timely manner. Alejandro Also replaced the outside faucet and it’s a super clean install. This company is rock solid.

reviews.author: Lindsey Carney
reviews.text: Plumber Gerald was professional and He was diligent in fixing a difficult plumbing issue. Once the issue was solved, he thoroughly cleaned up the task areas. The price was less than anticipated too. I endorse Home Angels!

reviews.author: Gabriel19 F
reviews.text: I can’t say enough to express how satisfied I am with Colby. He arrived out the same day job through all different obstacles that came our way & did an amazing job. Other companies wouldn’t even give me the time of day. I wish I would have called him first. I will next time.

reviews.author: Luis Roach
reviews.text: My experience was positive. Chad was polite, and after he cleared my line, he verified that there were no other clogs.

reviews.author: braxton barnett
reviews.text: Had a good experience with this company. Had some heat pump concerns and Terry L. arrived out. He was on time, and professional, and answered all my questions. Would use again!

reviews.author: Travis Glass
reviews.text: When I call this number on 10/17/2023 it sends me to an answering service and then sends me to RotoRooter. I assume Curtis and Sons Plumbing is no longer in business.

reviews.author: Oliver Maddox
reviews.text: I had a very unusual plumbing problem at my home right before Christmas. All 5 toilets backed up at the same time, which was especially stressful with a newborn at home. A plumbing crew arrived within a few hours and quickly got to work. Raymond, the manager, assured me they would find the sewer line problem and fix it, and that is exactly what they did. They worked late into the evening and came back the next morning to finish the job properly in the daylight. The issue ended up being that another utility crew had drilled through my sewer main while installing new lines. Ernest, the technician, was friendly, professional, and easy to work with. I really appreciated how fast they responded and how carefully they handled such a major drain and sewer repair.

reviews.author: B R Glass
reviews.text: A few days after moving into my new home in Hickory, I found wastewater backing up into the basement from the main sewer line. My home warranty company sent out a plumber, and Jared arrived quickly and got right to work. He figured out the issue fast, cleared the blockage, and explained in simple terms how the drain and sewer pipes under the house were set up. He also gave me helpful tips on routine plumbing care and how to help prevent future backups and clogs. The whole service call was smooth, professional, and very reassuring. Jared did a fantastic job, kept me informed during the repair, and made a very stressful plumbing problem much easier to deal with. I felt completely relieved once the sewer line was flowing properly again. I’m very grateful for the excellent plumbing service and will definitely call them again for any drain, sewer, or plumbing repair I need in Hickory.

reviews.author: Maxwell Andrews
reviews.text: i’ve had raymond and jared out several times for plumbing repairs through my home warranty, and each visit went better than expected. They showed up quickly, explained the pipe issues in simple terms, and got right to work. My kids even gave jared a funny nickname because he puts on the white coveralls and crawls under the house to handle drain and water line problems, then comes back out wet and dirty after fixing everything. Every time they have been here, the workmanship has been solid and dependable. They did more than just make a quick pipe patch and leave. They found additional leaks, replaced damaged plumbing, repaired areas where pests had chewed the pipes, and sealed up the openings to help protect the home. That kind of extra care means a lot when you want the job done right the first time. What stands out most is their honesty and the way they look out for the house. If raymond or jared says something needs attention, i believe it because they are upfront, practical, and clearly focused on preventing bigger plumbing problems later. I read a lot of reviews before letting anyone work on my home, and these plumbers have earned my trust more than other companies i have dealt with. Right now we also need a shower install and vanity plumbing finished, and even though their schedule stays busy, i would rather wait for a team i trust. We have another bathroom, so it is not an emergency, and that makes it easier to hold out for quality work. For any plumbing repair, drain issue, leak repair, or bathroom plumbing project, these are the people i would want handling it. Keep up the hard work raymond and jared.

reviews.author: Kimberly M
reviews.text: Curtis & Sons Plumbing was great to work with. After a septic backup, I needed to update part of my septic and plumbing system, and the team took time to listen, explain my options, and make sure I got the right materials and fittings for the job. Jared and Raymond were helpful, easy to talk to, and clearly knew their plumbing products. The pricing was very fair, close to what you might find online, and the product quality was better than what I had seen at big box stores. The schedule 40 pipe and other supplies felt sturdier and more dependable, which mattered for a repair that needed to last. What cost a little more was easy to understand once I saw the difference in quality. I also appreciated that they did not rush anyone. Even when my wife brought in a parts list, they checked everything carefully and helped make sure the septic and drain line items matched what we actually needed. That kind of customer service is hard to find. If you need plumbing or septic advice in Hickory, they are knowledgeable, patient, and willing to help both homeowners and people in the trades.

reviews.author: J G Paul
reviews.text: my water heater started leaking across the floor, and i needed a plumber fast in hickory. a friend recommended ernest, and i’m very glad i called. he was polite, professional, and easy to talk with from the start. he explained my plumbing options in simple terms and helped me choose the best fix for my home. he arrived on time, removed the old unit, and installed a new 50 gallon hot water heater the same day. the whole job was handled smoothly, and his workmanship was excellent. he was honest, respectful, and clearly knew his plumbing work. the price was better than i expected, and everything was left clean and working great. i’m extremely satisfied and now have a reliable plumber to call for any future water heater or plumbing issues. definitely recommend.
